title: Quantitative PCR Analysis of Gene Expression in Hyperglycemic Larval Zebrafish
author: Sandra Rieger
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3bagiie
materials: Preparation of mRNA from larval zebrafish. Pool 10 zebrafish larvae and isolate RNA according to the RNeasy Mini Kit (QIAGEN) manual. Elute final mRNA in 30 μl of RNase-free water.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA from mRNA
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from isolated mRNA using the SuperScript®III First-Strand Synthesis System (Life Technologies) with either oligo(dT) or random hexamer primers.

steps.title: Dilute ROX reference dye
steps.instruction: Dilute the ROX reference dye 1:500 using nuclease-free PCR-grade water.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR reagent mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the following components in the specified order to create a reagent mixture for replicate reactions (including at least one reaction volume excess):

substeps.instruction: Add 10 μl of 2× SYBR Green QPCR Master Mix
Add upstream primer at optimized concentration (200–500 nM)
Add downstream primer at optimized concentration (200–500 nM)
Add 0.3 μl of diluted ROX reference dye
Add nuclease-free PCR-grade water to bring the final volume to 20 μl (accounting for the cDNA to be added)

steps.title: Distribute mixture and add cDNA
steps.instruction: Gently mix the reagent mixture without creating bubbles and distribute it into experimental reaction tubes.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5-50 ng (x μl) of cDNA to each reaction to reach a final reaction volume of 20 μl

steps.title: Perform qPCR amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the transcripts using the following PCR thermal cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: 40 cycles of: 95ºC for 15 seconds and 60ºC for 20 seconds
Melting curve analysis: 95ºC for 1 minute, 60ºC for 30 seconds, and 95ºC for 30 seconds
